feat: add Cronometer Unlock Gold patch

Unlocks Cronometer Gold (fasting tracker, custom charts/biometrics, diary
timestamps & groups, advanced reports, ad-free) without a subscription.

Cronometer is a Flutter app with no Gold logic in the DEX, so this is a
rawResourcePatch that byte-patches lib/arm64-v8a/libapp.so: it locates the
User gold-override setter by a byte signature (anchored on the field_63
store) and NOPs the conditional branch so the override is always stored
true. Every in-app Gold gate reads that override first, so this unlocks
them all at once. Located by signature, not a fixed offset; verified
end-to-end on 4.56.0.

fix: actually unlock BlockerHero premium (force cached isPremium state)

The original Enable Premium patch forced the `e()` pref getter and `l()`
(isLoggedIn) true, which flipped the "Premium" badge but left every feature
gate closed — adding an 11th blocklist item, focus-mode timers, etc. still
showed the free-tier limit.

Root cause (found by running it on a device, not just verifying bytecode):
the gates don't read `e(g())` live — they read the CACHED `isPremium` field
off the `PreferencesState` (`Y3.c`) StateFlow snapshot. That cache is
populated from the stored pref, which is false on a fresh/re-signed/billing-
less install, so hooking the getter never reaches it.

Fix: force `PreferencesState.isPremium` on at the data class constructor
(2nd ctor param) so every snapshot reports premium. Kept the `e()` hook (for
the few live `e(g())` reads like focus mode's one-timer check and the badge)
and the `l()` force (the outer login gate the feature checks hit first).

Verified end-to-end in an emulator: blocklist accepts >10 keywords/apps,
focus mode opens, and the Premium screen shows "Your Premium features".

fix: drop server-inserted sponsored timeline cards in Tumblr Remove ads

Forcing UserInfo.v0() false only disables the client ad SDKs. The dashboard
response still carries server-inserted ad/sponsored Timelineable types the
timeline-object factory built untouched (backfill_ad, sponsored_day,
takeover_banner, client_side_ad and the SDK ad payloads), so they rendered as
in-feed sponsored posts. Drop the four ad base classes (ClientAd,
ClientSideAdMediation, advertising.ServerSideAd, advertising.SimpleAd) at the
same factory chokepoint before the Post check, and fail loud if any injected
model class or the blaze getters change shape.
